impact_narrative: Inventory pods are OOM-restarting every ~6 hours; downstream checkout and orders see brief error bursts on each restart.
cause_summary: Commit c3d4e5f6a7 replaced the bounded LRU SKU cache with a plain dict that never evicts, so memory grows linearly with unique SKU lookups.

runbook_citation.heading_path: Inventory Service Runbook > Memory growth and OOM restarts
runbook_citation.why: Covers heap-dump triage and the cache-related mitigation for inventory.

next_steps: Revert c3d4e5f6a7 or hotfix the cache back to a bounded LRU.
Restart inventory pods off-peak to reset RSS.
Add a memory-growth alert at 70% to catch leaks before OOM.
